description: Auto-height column flex containers sized as Chromium 153 sizes them, by their items' hypothetical main sizes (flex base sizes clamped by min and max sizes), as shadcn-svelte's input groups with a block addon: a growing text area with field-sizing: content and a min-height (typing grows it past its min-height, deleting shrinks it back, a class switch raises the min-height), text inputs with a content flex basis and a fixed height (as tall as their inner editor's normal line), a fixed text area with an automatic flex basis, overflow-hidden scroll containers below a min-height and above a max-height, and an item with min-height: 0 that contributes its flex basis and overflows its group
